div.head: Ordal 5
div.ab: Et bibat (accusatus) aquam benedictam, et inde conspergatur manus eius, qua iudicium portare debet; et sic adeat.
(Und Verklagter trinke Weihwasser, und damit werde seine Hand, mit der er das Ordal[eisen] tragen soll, besprengt fehlt H) und so trete er hin zu[r Ableistung].
(And let the accused drink holy water, and let his hand with which he is to carry the ordeal [iron] be sprinkled with it — lacking in H) and so let him go up to [perform it].
[And the accused shall go to the ordeal,]
div.note: H lacks the beginning of 5; Liebermann supplies the sense from the Quadripartitus, printed in bold there.
